column1: # name<TAB>arguments (shell words, run in this directory; "< file" = stdin). NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 convert2blastmask, the official Linux x64 release (local oracle), 2026-11-13, ad-RG-K-6 (line RG item K3):

# in/ made by remaining-gaps-20261112/K/k3/probe/gen_inputs.py; conf/malformed.ini is that of tests/segmasker. Run without LOSAT_, NCBI_ and BLAST variables but NCBI_CONFIG_PATH (this directory) and BLAST_USAGE_REPORT=false (NCBI only).

# Not frozen: -version, -version-full and -xmlhelp (LOSAT prints its own versions, NCBI's forms with LOSAT's package, and refuses -xmlhelp, as dustmasker; line RG item E3), the -out /dev/full rows of the maskinfo formats (LOSAT refuses a failed write of the serial stream) and -masking_options with a byte outside the visible ASCII range in maskinfo_asn1_text and maskinfo_asn1_bin (NCBI writes # for it and posts an error; LOSAT refuses it, as in an archive).

# gapwrap0_* and gapwrap1_* (>? lines that sum to 2^32 or more; RG DECISIONS K3-6): frozen on ws with its NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 (env_blast) under a 32 GiB address space, since NCBI allocates the run of N of gapwrap1 (4 GiB, 8.4 GB resident); in/gapwrap*.fa written by hand.
